2609.24352.title: Few-Shot Demonstrations Elicit the Use of In-Context World Representations in LLMs
2609.24352.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs), when acting as agents, are expected to take observed data in context, infer the latent state space underlying the world, and leverage it for downstream prediction. However, prior work demonstrated that LLMs struggle to use representations learned in context on a graph tracking task, where the model needs to construct a representation of the graph governing data generation process and use it for subsequent predictions. In this paper, we show that extending this to few-shot settings, where each demonstration is generated from a different world with either the same or different graph topologies, enhances its prediction on 6 models from 4 model families. To understand this improvement, we linearly probe a low-dimensional world representation that encodes graph information in the hidden states. Notably, we find that few-shot demonstrations relocate the world representation and increase its predictive use. Specifically, for each model, these world representations shift in directions nearly orthogonal to their original subspace, and interventions on these representations selectively impair performance more than interventions on other subspaces. Consistent with this insight, we show that few-shot demonstrations with observations from different worlds improve performance on ARC-AGI-1&2, web agent tasks, and Othello. Our findings elucidate the role and internal mechanisms of few-shot demonstrations in in-context world modeling. More broadly, our work advances our understanding of how LLM agents learn from in-context observations and provides implications for their further improvement.
2609.24352.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）在作為代理時，預期能夠在上下文中處理觀察到的數據，推斷出潛在的狀態空間，並利用其進行後續預測。<lb/>然而，先前的研究顯示，LLMs在圖形追蹤任務中難以使用在上下文中學習到的表示，該任務要求模型構建一個表示數據生成過程的圖形，並將其用於後續的預測。<lb/>在本文中，我們展示了將這一點擴展到少量示範的設置，其中每個示範都是從不同的世界生成的，無論是相同還是不同的圖形拓撲，能夠增強其在4個模型家族中的6個模型上的預測能力。<lb/>為了理解這一改進，我們對編碼圖形信息的低維世界表示進行了線性探測。<lb/>值得注意的是，我們發現少量示範重新定位了世界表示並增加了其預測使用。<lb/>具體而言，對於每個模型，這些世界表示在幾乎與其原始子空間正交的方向上移動，並且對這些表示的干預比對其他子空間的干預更能選擇性地損害性能。<lb/>與這一見解一致，我們顯示來自不同世界的少量示範在ARC-AGI-1&2、網絡代理任務和奧賽羅上的表現有所提升。<lb/>我們的研究結果闡明了少量示範在上下文世界建模中的角色和內部機制。<lb/>更廣泛地說，我們的工作推進了對LLM代理如何從上下文觀察中學習的理解，並為其進一步改進提供了啟示。
